Young adults, registration is closing soon for the 2026 Young Adult L.I.F.E. Retreat! 🌿

Join young adults from across the Georgia-Cumberland Conference at Cohutta Springs, October 30 to November 1, for a weekend of worship, community, spiritual growth, and time away together.

This year’s theme is “Stronger Together” with Angelo Grasso as the main speaker.

📅 October 30 to November 1
📍 Cohutta Springs
⏰ Registration closes September 28
🔗 events.gccsda.com/yal26

Abide: Young Adult Campout
October 16–18 at Ellijay SDA Church’s McKinney Park.
A weekend to slow down, spend time outdoors, worship together, and enjoy some good community.
Weekend registration is $40 and includes camping and all meals. A $15 Sabbath day pass is also available and includes lunch.
Bring your own camping gear. Registration is due October 11.
Register at onpurposeya.com.

What a beautiful Sabbath! On July 11, the On Purpose young adults were absolutely blessed to lead out in the church service. We focused on the theme of "Overcoming," drawing deep inspiration and strength from 1 John 5.

Thank you to everyone who joined us in worship and supported our young adult ministry. Let's continue to overcome together! 🙏✨

#OnPurpose #YoungAdultMinistry #Overcoming #1John5 #SabbathWorship

Such an amazing gym night! We kicked things off with worship and a powerful reminder that setbacks are never permanent. Then we hit the courts for some basketball and volleyball. Nothing beats good competition and an even better community!

Everything we did this year was for His glory. Looking back at our 2025 journey from the quiet moments of Young Adult Sabbath to the high energy of GYC, we are just so incredibly thankful for how the Lord has led us.

He provided the strength for our hikes, the joy in our socials, and the spiritual growth in our hearts. We give Him all the praise for the community He has built here. 🤍

This past weekend a few of us got to attend GYC and experience what it means to See the Invisible. It was such an amazing blessing, reminding ourselves to always rely on God, even when we can’t see Him. The atmosphere at GYC is a blessing, and you really do feel the presence of the Holy Spirit there. From the worships to the praise in the prayer room.
